provenance.claim_boundary: One H200 GPU, public-source-derived synthetic compact Gated-MLA cache against an independently materialized key/value cache. Reports allocator peaks and sampled device use for the declared cache-construction and held-cache lifetime only; no production kernel, model, serving, physical-traffic, or quality claim.

fixture.seed_rule: seed_base plus zero-based cell index in batch, prefix, heads, dtype order
fixture.packing: Each request retains only its own accepted prefix and one newly accepted token; cache records are concatenated in request order.
fixture.workload_link: This full frozen shape/prefix/precision grid is the validated CH06 phase-measurement workload boundary; later timing cards require separate admission and cannot borrow this memory outcome.

parity_gate.cache: Before memory sampling, reconstruct all per-head keys and values from the owned compact cache and require exact storage-dtype equality with the materialized cache; verify all source tensors are unchanged.
parity_gate.continuation: For each request, compare the accepted-token compact and materialized attention plus gated final output. Require finite values and maximum absolute error <= 0.05 or relative RMS error <= 0.02 for each tensor.
parity_gate.failure_policy: A parity failure blocks memory interpretation for that cell; retain the failure and do not replace the cell.

memory_policy.live_buffers: Identical input, accepted-prefix latent/shared records, newly projected record, and weights remain resident in both arms. The candidate or materialized cache is separately owned and held live through sampling; outputs and parity caches are released before sampling.
memory_policy.lifetime: After two warmups, clear unused allocator blocks, synchronize, capture baseline, construct and hold the owned cache, capture allocator and device observations, then release and synchronize. Repeat independently five times per arm and cell.
memory_policy.estimator: median of five raw within-arm incremental peak bytes; retain all samples and min/max range
memory_policy.device_metric: Maximum sampled device-used bytes from synchronized mem_get_info at baseline and while the owned cache is live; this is a sampled high-water observation, not an unsampled transient device peak.
memory_policy.sampling_policy: Sample device use at baseline, after each materialized key/value stage, and while the final cache is held. Measure the common-input baseline separately in every repetition.
memory_policy.oom_policy: Retain OOM or runtime failure for the affected arm/cell; no retry, fallback, or selective exclusion.
memory_policy.stopping_rule: Attempt all 48 ordered cells and both arms, retaining every valid, invalid, OOM, or unsupported disposition.
